title: Drain fixtures: at-least-once delivery proven and the harness hardened
action: Extend tests/pi_plugin_contracts.rs: harness gains a hard timeout on run_harness (a hung node is a red test naming the timeout, never a CI hang) and a sendUserMessage-capable stub pi recording calls. Rows: busy->steer, idle->trigger with F1 latch, failed-injection requeue, orphan .processing reclaim at session_start, replay-after-restart injects again with the SAME job id (the documented at-least-once behavior — test name says at-least-once), marker-without-result not injected, no-marker sync job never injected, fence is header-only (a report body containing a fence never appears in the injection), drain never throws on missing dirs/malformed marker/malformed result, every new pi.on event added to the never-throw hand list (pi_plugin_contracts.rs:1202-1210). All existing fixtures still terminate.

truths: replay-after-restart row is named at-least-once and green
every fixture terminates under the harness timeout
key_links: rows derive event names and fence shape from the TS source, never a hand copy

trace.outcome: Drain fixtures prove at-least-once delivery, header-only fences and a never-throw drain; the Pi harness is now timeout-bounded and records injections
